description: District Secretariat - The Esala festival of Saparagamu Maha Saman Devalaya - 2024
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the schedule and regulations for the Esala Festival of Saparagamu Maha Saman Devalaya. The content focuses on cultural/religious festival arrangements, including dates, camp area boundaries, vehicle restrictions, health guidelines, trade regulations, and environmental measures. This does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9), making it a Miscellaneous gazette dealing with cultural/administrative matters.
